name: china-itinerary-analysis
description: Review canvas for the China itinerary — a rendering of the plan held in Postgres.
comment: THE PAGE has no dependencies and never will — index.html is self-contained, which is why
it can be opened from a file:// URL or served by GitHub Pages with no build step.
This manifest is for the BUILD, and it exists for one script: check-against-db.mjs needs a
Postgres driver to prove the page agrees with the database. That check is the whole reason
the canvas can be trusted, so a dependency to run it is worth having.
